titulo.alumno: Understanding «according to» or «depends on» with «によって»

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

piezas.titulo: «によって» can mark differences by person, method, cause or agent; the noun and the predicate make the meaning concrete.
texto: 人によって違う = varies from person to person. 調査によって明らかになった = was made clear through the survey. Don't reduce every use to "by".
ひと に よって、 すき な たべもの は ちがいます。 (The favourite food varies from person to person.)
ちょうさ に よって、 りようしゃ の へんか が わかりました。 (Through the survey, the change among users became known.)
